issue.title: bgp neighbors doesnt come up with vlan subinterface and bgp neighbor config

failure.body:
#### Description
When I try to configure BGP neighbor with vlan sub interface, I dont see running config reflecting the same and show ip bgp summary doesnt show neighbor. The following is on vswitch . Added the below on config_db.json.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Bring up image
2. configure vlan subintf and bgp neighbor
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
   "VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE": {
        "Ethernet16.1": {
            "admin_status": "up"
        },
        "Ethernet16.1|<IP>/24": {}
    },
    "BGP_NEIGHBOR": {
        "<IP>": {
            "rrclient": "0",
            "name": "to_tgen",
            "local_addr": "<IP>",
            "nhopself": "0",
            "holdtime": "180",
            "asn": "200",
            "keepalive": "60",
            "admin_status": "up"
        },

After config reload, dint see the entry on the show running o/p and not on bgp summary as well.

However, I could configure the same via frr.

sonic(config)# neighbor <IP> activ^C
sonic(config)# router bgp ^C
sonic(config)# router bgp 65100
sonic(config-router)# neighbor <IP> remote-as 200
sonic(config-router)# address-family ipv4 unicast
sonic(config-router-af)# neighbor <IP> activate
sonic(config-router-af)# exit-address-family
sonic(config-router)# exit
sonic# show running-config
Building configuration...

After this, I could see the output on show running config as well as show ip bgp summ

resolution.title: [bgpcfgd] Enable BGP sessions over subinterfaces
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Neetha John <<EMAIL>>

Fixes #7531

#### Why I did it
To enable bgp sessions to be established over subinterfaces

#### How I did it
Listen to VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE table in config db

#### How to verify it
Bgp sessions were established successfully
